global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with golden noodles, topped with chashu pork, nori, menma, and naruto. Served in a blue-patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Light wooden table surface with smooth texture, warm yellowish tone, and subtle grain patterns visible.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a blue and white patterned rim with intricate scrollwork design.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is golden-yellow, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green flecks.
regions.spoon: A pale, glossy ceramic spoon with smooth, curved surface and slightly flared end.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark, glossy, rectangular, with a slightly uneven, textured surface and visible specks.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows golden-brown seared surface with visible fat marbling and pepper specks, irregularly shaped.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as translucent amber strips with ridged texture and glossy surface.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale yellow, smooth, oval-shaped with subtle pinkish swirl, glossy surface.
